description: Exceptional 280 m² apartment on the 3rd floor with lift, in one of the most prestigious areas of the 16th arrondissement. A spacious reception room and dining room for 8, three refined double bedrooms, three bathrooms, one with a bathtub and double washbasin, and a fully equipped kitchen: every detail has been thought out to accommodate up to 8 people in absolute comfort and rare elegance. An exceptional property, a stone's throw from Avenue Foch.The spaceThe apartment280 m², 3rd floor with liftUp to 8 people- Large living room and dining room for 8 people- Bedroom 1: double bed- Bedroom 2: double bed, sofa bed- Bedroom 3: double bed, office area- Bathroom 1: bathtub, double basin, toilet- Bathroom 2: shower, double basin- Bathroom 3: shower, double basin- Equipped kitchen: oven, microwave, Nespresso, kettle, cookware, full set of dishes- TV- Wi-Fi- Bed linen and towels providedGuest accessNeighbourhood and transportPrestigious residential area in the 16th arrondissement, a stone's throw from Avenue Foch.- Rue de la Pompe metro station (line 9): 2 minutes' walk- Victor Hugo metro station (line 2): 5 minutes' walk- Buses 52 and 63: in the immediate vicinity- Bois de Boulogne: 15-minute walk- Champs Elysees: 10 min by MetroOther things to noteWe would like to inform you that check-ins are possible between 4pm and 9pm.Even in case of self check-in, our team can be reached by message in the evening if there is any need. However, after 9pm, we will not be able to guarantee immediate intervention or instant resolution of any problem related to check-in, access to the accommodation or an on-site issue.We appreciate your understanding and remain at your disposal to best prepare for your arrival. – hotel-type listing
